<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the only peaks in the typical methyl carbon region (~10‑30 ppm) are at 19.40 ppm, which appears twice, indicating two equivalent methyl carbons. No other peaks fall in the methyl range. Therefore, the molecule contains 2 methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
